body:
Tell me your whole vibe in three words and Mood finds your Taylor song. it's the most us thing on the whole site and i cannot stop playing with it 🤍

three of my favorites to try:
— crying in the car, cinematically
— feral about a bridge
— winning, quietly

tap the one that's you today and it pulls the song that fits, right away — no login, nothing you type is saved.

so which one is you? tag the friend who's the total opposite and make them tell on themselves too.

Photo: Taylor on the folklore set, Eras Tour, Inglewood 2023 — Paolo Villanueva (CC BY 2.0), via Wikimedia Commons.

altText: Taylor Swift performing the folklore set of the Eras Tour in Inglewood, 2023, on a moss-covered cottage stage set.
why: IG sibling of the Sept slot-2-of-2 Mood beat. Same three chips as the X post, quoted verbatim from mood-starters.ts, but a distinct opener (direct address, first five words differ from the X sibling) and IG-length breathing room. The calendar assigned mood-feature.png to slide 2 only if it shows Mood mid-use — but that asset is a designed typography card ('Tell it how you feel'), not the feature in actual use, so it fails the 'cool feature only' rule and there is no slide 2 (photo-only). Media: folklore-inglewood-2023, a scored-era Taylor photo (folklore IS scored, so the tile cannot imply Mood returns unscored-era songs) whose cozy/introspective look suits a mood poll; distinct from the X sibling's reputation tile per L001. photoEra intentionally unset (Mood is cross-era/non-themed) and the caption claims no folklore-era relevance for the photo. All 10 library photos shipped within the last 5 days, so this reuse (last used 09-20) is a diversity warning, not a hard fail — unavoidable with a 10-photo library now that both platforms need a distinct tile. Share hook required (mood) and present.

critique.rationale: September's last Mood slot and Mood has never shipped once — the site's most distinctive feature finally gets a hero post with three real chips and a genuine tag hook. Scored-era folklore photo so the tile implies nothing false; photo-only because our only Mood screenshot is a typography card, not the feature in use.
